criteria.text: The final deliverable is an Excel workbook named consolidated_review_harborview_media_group.xlsx.
The workbook states the Q1 2025 reporting period of January 1 through March 31, 2025.
The workbook states the CAD-to-USD rate of 0.74.
The workbook records Lattice Digital ownership starting February 1, 2025 with a proration factor of approximately 0.6556.

The workbook clearly presents assumptions, source data, consolidated rollup by label, reconciliation of excluded transactions, and a board-facing recommendation; equivalent worksheet labels are acceptable.
The workbook reports total consolidated Q1 2025 revenue of approximately $1,590,686.30.
Lattice Digital consolidated USD is approximately $697,267.02, reflecting about 65.6% proration of its approximately $1,063,627.65 gross Q1 figure for the February 1, 2025 acquisition.
Cascade Creative consolidated USD is approximately $452,853.28, reflecting CAD-to-USD conversion at the 0.74 period rate.
Beacon Media consolidated USD is approximately $440,566.01 for the full quarter.
The reconciliation documentation identifies void, cancelled, and out-of-period ledger rows that were excluded from consolidated revenue.
The workbook cites cascade_creative_fx_and_period_reference.txt as the source for the 0.74 CAD-to-USD rate.
The workbook cites lattice_digital_acquisition_memo.txt as the source for the February 1, 2025 acquisition and proration treatment.
The workbook documents judgment calls where sources disagree, including mid-period acquisition proration and exclusion of non-counting transactions.
The workbook includes a board-facing recommendation to report consolidated Q1 2025 revenue after FX conversion, exclusions, and Lattice acquisition proration.
Derived consolidated USD totals use live formulas rather than hard-coded values.
The workbook reconciles label totals to harborview_media_group_brand_ledger.csv rather than introducing revenue figures absent from that ledger.
The deliverable includes Lattice Digital revenue dated before February 1, 2025 in the consolidated Q1 2025 total.
The deliverable includes transaction HM-4001 from December 2024 in the consolidated Q1 2025 revenue total.
The deliverable includes transaction HM-3007 from April 2025 in the consolidated Q1 2025 revenue total.
